scope: Unreleased current-route rigid retainers and films; no Raytac acceptance inherited

tolerance_contract.bondline_scope: Matched/finished bonding faces; inspect bondline and remaining webs on the actual post-cured case. Does not assume independent untrimmed print errors fit a 0.1 mm bondline.

material_candidate.guides: Tough SLA engineering resin or machined insulating polymer; supplier must meet the inspected surface and wall limits
material_candidate.film: 3M 5413 polyimide tape, nominal 0.069 mm; incoming total thickness <=0.075 mm including adhesive; bond/pull qualification open
material_candidate.thickness_scope: 0.069 mm is a typical manufacturer value, not a guaranteed maximum. <=0.075 mm is the project incoming limit; measure the actual lot.
